author: Myv
body:
Hey there, me and {tag=883055fb316542919ded7f279ff5381f} are back to present out latest map for the CTW Contest, Plaza.



Information
Team Colours: Black and White
Loadout: Included in images
Gamemode: Capture The Wool (2 wools per team)
Yes, there are also some sneaky spots.

2 exp bottles and 1 golden apple will be awarded per kill.

Map Logistics
Server hosted: alexanderjoe
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/4fdofi9s00qjk6z/MyvCTW2.rar
XML: https://maps.avicus.net/atlas/MapTesting/Contest/PlazaCTW/map.xml

Album: https://imgur.com/a/eOlti

Please feel free to leave feedback below, we appreciate all support.

Thank you,

Myv and Skii
